notes.title: New GSim Update
notes.notes:
Hi :)

Added a new multiplayer level, fixed some bugs, changed a lot of stuff. Please post any bugs in the forums if you run into any. I will fix asap.

notes.title: Update V0.07
notes.notes:
Fixed bugs
-More than 3 grannies should be able to play in a single game. Its hard to test this one but it should be working. 2-8 players should hopefully be working a lot better.
-Game will only close if the host leaves the game.
-The granny can no longer spam "E" to pick up health and get more than 20HP.
-Players can no longer join games already in session.
-Screen resolution wasn't being set properly. Different screen resolutions should work now.

Improvements
-Toddler can no longer knock the granny over by bumping/ jumping into her.
-Single player granny AI is a little better, she should no longer be able to shoot/ kick while she is getting up from being knocked down.

Features
-Most doors can be broken if a player hits them while rag dolling.


Different operating systems
Mac and Linux machines should be able to play the game now. Its hard for me to test whether they work or not because I don't own a Mac or Linux machine. If you have any problems trying to run the game while using Mac or Linux please let me know and I'll try to fix it.


The game is getting pretty big now and it's easy for me to miss bugs. If you run into any please leave a comment on the bug reporting thread.

notes.title: Halloween update V0.06
notes.notes:
-Added new Halloween level.
-Added skins.
-Added chat to the lobby.
-Players look less jittery across the network.
-Improved the granny's AI on single player.
And a bunch of other stuff I forgot about.

Next update will probably be bug fixes.

If you see any bugs or have feed back leave a comment here or on the discussion board.

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Update V0.05
notes.notes:
-The player collision is a lot better. Shouldn't get stuck in or on objects as much.
-Added a chat box.
-Added a language filter. Press escape while in game to enable or disable it.
-Removed the floating health bars. They are now on the top right of the screen.

Also there is a bug currently where you can't have more than 3 grannies in one game.

notes.title: Small bug fix V0.041
notes.notes: -Some players were invisible to each other.

notes.title: Update V0.04
notes.notes:
This new update is kind of a test for the new 2-8 player game mode. There may be some issues I haven't seen yet and if you come across any please let me know in the bug reporting thread.

Most of the time spent on this update was for the new game mode so there wasn't too much content added to the game. I'm making a new map for the new game mode and it's about 50% done.

-Added steel toe boots(the granny can kick the kid much further) which can be found down stairs in the tall open able closest.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34822740/8310b949eef8b26d5d8ffd0ca6518c67bba0d6cb.png
-Added throw able tiki torches out side.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34822740/e6e6d200c5f117584003d53a6d71b7ca0c60fa97.jpg
-I changed the way the items are thrown so its easier to hit what your aiming at.
-The grannies HP bar is now floating above the player instead of the top right corner.
-With the new game mode there is a "spectate mode" when you die.

notes.title: Update V0.03
notes.notes:
This is more of a patch rather than an update. I know I said the next update will add more content to the game but the api I was using just randomly stopped working so I had to fix that. The next update will add more content to the game.

-There were issues with the api I was using to send and receive data from steams server which made players unable to create/join lobbies. I switched to a different api and everything should be working now.

-I added a feature where if the granny or grandson gets stuck in the wall, you should teleport to a nearby room so you are not stuck forever.


I'm working on increasing the max players that are allowed to join a game so there may be new bugs that I haven't noticed. If you see any please leave a comment in the "Bug reporting thread" and I'll fix them.

I Also have a twitter account: https://twitter.com/SimulatorGranny

notes.title: Update V0.02
notes.notes:
-Can now Remap keybindings(while in game using the escape menu")
-Increase item and key spawn amount
-Fixed some multiplayer issues
-Fixed some bugs on level 3.

Next update will add more content to the game. Maybe a different multiplayer mode with more than two players in a game.

notes.title: Small bug fixes v0.01
notes.notes:
-Fixed a connecting issue
-Fixed a bug that stopped the player from playing single player.

If you're still having issues connecting to other players make sure your game is up to date before posting anything to the discussion board.

notes.title: New update with new house
notes.notes:
I added a new map with different tasks. imo its the best level by far, The physics 
feel way better in this update.

-Added small cubby holes for the toddler to hide in/ navigate the map.
-Added different endings to the tasks.
-The toddler also has tasks on this map.
-Added different animations for the granny.
-Increased the brightness for the dark levels.
-Fixed a few issues with the rag doll physics. 
-And a bunch of other stuff I forgot about.


-There's a bug where if u finish a multiplayer game you wont be able to play single player. You will have to reload the game to play single player.
-There's also a bug if you try joining a friends lobby while you are hosting a lobby the game will freeze when the "Connecting" text pops up. If you restart the game it should work fine.

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
-Added a molotov cocktail.
-Added a grenade.
-Added a new chest. The grenade and molotov can be found in the new chests.
-Hammers and wrenches now also spawn in the chests that the grandson can unlock.
-Added invert mouse setting.(While in game press the  "Escape" key to change mouse settings).
-Added health indicator beside the granny's hp bar. When her health changes a number will appear beside her health bar indicating how much it was changed by.
-Lowered the damage on most of the throw able items.
-Fixed a bunch of bugs.

notes.title: Multiplayer update
notes.notes:
The new update should fix the network errors some people were having.
-Added a new level for multiplayer.

If you run into any errors or bugs I might of missed please post them in the bug discussion thread.

notes.title: Single player update
notes.notes:
Hey guys I hope you're enjoying the game so far.

Granny Simulator now has a single player mode. There's currently one level you can play on. I plan on adding more levels for single player and multiplayer in the near future. 

I'd appreciate it if you tell me in the comments what you think of the game so far and also what you would like to see more of (Different levels, weapons, expanding on the house, ect...).
